summary: State-change event trigger on a tracked entity. Compares the entity ID dwords at a2+16 and a3+16; when they match, reads the state dword at a2+20 and, if a3+20 differs, copies the new state into a3+20 and raises the trigger flags at this+0x0 and this+0x19A4 to 1. Returns a2 (or the matched state value). Called from TrackConfig (0042E530) and AIGearSelectionSet (0042EAA0) on the per-frame path.

local_names.this: event trigger object whose flags are raised on a detected state change
local_names.a2: reference entity: holds expected ID at +16 and source state at +20
local_names.a3: current entity: holds observed ID at +16 and state at +20 that is updated
local_names.result: a2 passed through, then the state value copied to a3+20

operations.description: result = a2: initialize the return value with the reference entity pointer
Guard on entity ID match: proceed only when *(a2+16) equals *(a3+16); otherwise return result without action
result = *(a2+20): read the reference entity state field
Guard on state change: proceed only when *(a3+20) differs from the reference state
*(a3+20) = result: copy the reference state into the current entity
this[0x19A4] = 1: raise the state-change-detected flag on the trigger object
this[0x0] = 1: raise the event-trigger flag at the start of the trigger object
Return result (the reference state value copied to the current entity)
